local function _ocwVmjEURINCgY(d, k)
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, #d do
        r[i] = string.char(bit32.bxor(d[i], k[(i % #k) + 1]))
    end
    return table.concat(r)
end

local function _sEEdIbnkRefYGF(s, n)
    local o = {}
    for i = 1, #s do

    end
    return table.concat(o)
end

local function _ZodfNmKRSaQBuQ()

    local result = {}
    local kl = #_NibmmjYPfpettj

    -- Reassemble chunks in correct order
    local ordered = {}
    for i = 1, #_LhbNxOwARVUklS do
        ordered[i] = _OxSpqBGkHnZLNa[_LhbNxOwARVUklS[i]]
    end

    -- Decrypt each byte through 3 reverse passes
    for ci = 1, #ordered do
        local chunk = ordered[ci]
        for bi = 1, #chunk do
            local b = chunk[bi]
            local ki = (pos % kl) + 1

            -- Reverse pass 3: undo position XOR + key3
            b = bit32.bxor(b, _sDVSyzSNBAspda[ki], bit32.band(pos, 255))

            result[#result + 1] = string.char(b)
            pos = pos + 1
        end
    end

    return table.concat(result)
end
